appDescription.message: Translates the word you select, taking the whole line into account. Works in subtitles, on any page and in PDF.

connectBody.message: This browser is not linked to your library yet.

reloaded.message: The extension reloaded. Refresh the page.

popupNotPaired.message: This browser is not linked to your library.

popupConnectGoogle.description: Popup button that signs in with Google

popupConnectCode.description: Popup button that shows the pairing code

popupEmpty.message: Nothing saved yet. Highlight a word on a page, in a PDF or in subtitles.

popupLibrary.description: Popup button that opens the web library

optSub.message: Highlight words on any site, in PDFs and in subtitles - they land in the same app on your phone.

optPairIntro.message: To link this browser to your library, confirm a code in the app on your phone.

optStep1.message: Open Subtitle Notes on your phone.

optPaired.message: Done. Highlight text on any page.

optExpired.message: The code expired. Get a new one.

optHotkeyHelp.message: Hold this combination while you highlight and the word goes straight to your library. Or highlight normally and press it afterwards.

optInstantHelp.message: Every highlight is saved at once, no keys at all. The card still offers to undo it.

optDragHint.message: A window pinned to a corner can be dragged with the mouse - it remembers where you put it.

optHideAfterHelp.message: Seconds the window stays up after an instant save.

optSubtitlesHelp.message: On YouTube and Netflix, replaces the captions with a copy where you can click a word or drag across a phrase.

optPauseHelp.message: When you pick a word out of a subtitle.

optSpeakHelp.message: Says the English out loud when the card opens.

optBlockedHelp.message: One address per line, for example mail.google.com.

optGoogleHelp.message: Sign in with the same Google account as on your phone - everything you save here lands in the same library.

optScanHelp.message: Point the phone’s camera at this square, or type the code in the app under Settings → Connected devices.

optLangHelp.message: New cards are explained in this language. Ones already saved keep the language they were written in.

optSubKeyHelp.message: While the key is held the line becomes selectable text. Let go and the player has its mouse back: dragging the subtitle, clicking to pause and the player’s own caption size all keep working.

optSubKeyNoneNow.message: Now: no key - the line is always selectable

optLangLocked.message: Connect an account first - the language is stored with it.

mineThanks.message: Saved. If others write the same, it becomes the default.

mineAgreed.message: Saved - enough people agree, so this is now the default.

tourStep1.message: Hold Ctrl and drag across the subtitle

tourStep1Body.message: Without the key the player is untouched: the line still drags, a click still pauses.

tourStep2Body.message: A page, a PDF, a comment. Hold Ctrl+Alt while you do it and it is saved without asking.

tourStep3Body.message: The same Google account on the phone, in the browser and on the computer.

optDesktopHelp.message: Subtitles in VLC and text in any program, into the same library.

optCompactHelp.message: Only the meaning: no synonyms, no notes.

optSpaceLine.description: Options toggle for translating the caption with space

optSpaceLineHelp.message: The caption on screen, translated but not saved.
